help.slug: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (e.g. residence-permit). It becomes part of the public URL: changing it changes the link.
help.italian_term: The term people will meet in real life, e.g. Permesso di soggiorno.
help.source_url: Must be https. For an "official" source the domain must be on the official allow-list.
help.source_type: Official sources are checked against the official domain list.
help.last_verified_at: The day someone last checked the information at the source. It cannot be in the future.
help.rights_note: Where the question comes from and the licence that lets EXPA use it (at least 5 characters). Required to publish.
help.license_type: Under what rights EXPA may use this question text. Without a licence the question cannot be published.
help.license_proof_ref: Contract number, permission letter or URL that proves the licence.
help.version: Letters, digits, dots, dashes. Unique per document, for example 2026-01.
help.tags: Lowercase words with dashes, separated by commas (max 10).
help.related_guides: Slugs of published guides, separated by commas.
help.blocks: Each block is official information (needs an https source from an official domain) or general guidance. Blocks are saved with the profile.
help.languages: Two-letter codes (ar, en, it), separated by commas.
help.threshold: Only for "greater than" and "less than" conditions.
help.basis: "Based on a source" needs a complete source before publishing.
help.audio_rights_note: Required with an audio URL: who owns the recording and under what terms.
help.content: Allowed keys: stem, sentence (with exactly one ___), choices, correct_index, answers, left. Match exercises list the left items here and the right items in the translated options, in the same order.
help.tax_year: The year the numbers apply to. Publishing needs a valid year.
help.brackets: Ascending by upper limit; the last bracket has no limit. Rates are 0 to 100.
help.nationality: Two capital letters such as EG, or * for every nationality.
help.residence_status: For example visa or residence_permit. Leave empty for any (applies to everyone).

content.confirmDelete: Delete this item permanently? Only drafts and archived items can be deleted.

content.warnReview: This item is in review. Saving any change sends it back to draft and it must be submitted for review again.
content.warnLive: This item is live or approved. Saving re-checks the publishing rules (translations, source, links); if they fail, the change is rejected.

about.title: About EXPA
about.lead: EXPA is a multilingual guide and assistant for foreigners who live, work or study in Italy. It is built Arabic-first, with English and Italian.

seo.title: About EXPA | Your life assistant in Italy
seo.description: What EXPA is, what it does, what it does not do and how its information is sourced.

mission.title: What we are building
mission.body: Moving to a new country means many offices, documents and deadlines. EXPA puts explanations in your language next to the Italian terms you will meet in real life, and helps you keep track of what you need to do next.

items.guides: Step-by-step guides for documents, services and daily life, each showing its source and when it was last verified.
items.assistant: An assistant that answers questions in Arabic, English or Italian and labels what is official information and what is an explanation.
items.tracking: Tools to keep track of your documents, deadlines and reminders.
items.learning: Italian lessons and driving licence practice focused on real life.

items.government: EXPA is an independent service. It is not a government website and is not affiliated with any public authority.
items.legal: Nothing here is legal, tax or medical advice. For your own case, ask a qualified professional or the competent office.
items.booking: EXPA does not book appointments or file applications for you. When a booking happens elsewhere, we link to the official site.
items.guarantee: We cannot guarantee that every detail is current or complete, or that an application will succeed.
items.providers: Third-party services and job listings are independent. Listing them is not an endorsement.

items.sources: Government information is based on official sources wherever they exist. We never invent procedures, fees, deadlines or links.
items.verified: Guides show the date they were last verified, and outdated ones are marked.
items.labels: Answers are labelled: official information, general guidance, AI explanation or third-party service.
items.privacy: We collect only what is needed to personalise EXPA, and you control your consents and your data in privacy settings.
